answer: A per-identity entry bond stops Sybil farms because every claimed agent needs its own locked stake. Registering 10,000 puppets costs 10,000 stakes, and overlap analysis that links two puppets to one operator burns both, so deleting accounts cannot recover capital. Paying the bond in a scarce onyx token keeps it from being minted to dilute price. Honest agents instead build reputation slowly in a trusted haven, history that cannot be bought in bulk. No willow-level audit army is needed; the bond math alone makes mass fabrication lose money.
